result.title: Show Me the Change You Want: Visual Example-Guided Change Detection
result.summary: Change detection identifies where images differ, but in practice users often seek only a particular kind of change. Existing referring change detection methods rely on predefined categories, textual descriptions, or annotated masks, limiting flexibility or requiring additional annotation. In this paper, we propose a new way to perform change detection, where an unannotated before-and-after image pair serves as a visual example to guide change localization in another pair. Our framework, Visual Example-Guided Change Detection (VECD), learns comparable attribute states from single images and introduces an example-conditioned readout to match changes across different objects and scenes. The example itself defines the request, without text, example masks, or test-time fine-tuning. We evaluate VECD on four datasets spanning rendered scenes and natural image edits: EditCLEVR, MagicBrush, HumanEdit, and MaskEdit. Experiments demonstrate cross-dataset generalization without fine-tuning: a single fixed example pair guides change detection across multiple scenes, even when examples and queries originate from different datasets. VECD selects matching changes in scenes with multiple simultaneous changes and returns an empty mask when the requested change is absent. It further generalizes to attribute families withheld from paired training, achieving 74.54\% to 93.38\% mIoU across four holdout settings. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/VECD

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VECD：用一对无标注的前后图像作为视觉示例，引导另一对图像中的变化定位，通过从单图学习可比较的属性状态并引入示例条件读出，实现无需文本、示例掩码或测试时微调的变化检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单图属性状态 + 示例条件读出」可能为 LVR 中如何按任务指定保留视觉细节、筛选相关视觉证据提供表示层面的借鉴线索；示例缺席时返回空掩码也可供核查与「停止/弃权」决策的类比，但论文本身不涉及多步推理或 latent 状态更新。
